zh: 這個不要辣,我不太能吃辣。
reference: No spicy for this one, please — I can't really handle spicy food.
inputTranscript: 这个不要啦，我不太能吃
outputTranscript: Forget this. I can't really handle spicy food.

judge.reason: The machine translation incorrectly translates '這個不要辣' (no spicy for this one) as 'Forget this' (which means rejecting the item entirely). This is a significant omission/distortion of the user's request, although the second part of the sentence is translated perfectly.

judge_x.reason: 譯文後半句“I can't really handle spicy food.”準確表達了原句我不太能吃辣；但前半句將“這個不要辣”(請不要辣/這份不要加辣)譯成“Forget this.”，改變了說話者意圖並加入了原文未有的指示，造成資訊遺失與誤導，因此語意忠實度下降。語句英文表達自然，故流暢度較高。
